Custard Pudding parfait.desc: A delightful glass parfait layered with sweet cream and fresh fruit, crowned with a rich baked custard flan, whipped cream, and a cherry. Sweet, creamy, and visually stunning!

Choco Dream.desc: Rich, chocolate-dipped biscuit with a creamy filling that melts in your mouth...

Strawberry Delight.desc: Light and airy vanilla sponge cake layered with generous amounts of freshly whipped cream and juicy, ripe strawberries. A timeless, refreshing favorite!

Fruity Dream.desc: A light, airy vanilla sponge cake layered with fluffy whipped cream and a colorful medley of fresh seasonal fruits, including banana, grapes, and citrus. Bright, refreshing, and perfectly sweet!

Midsummer Matcha Magic.desc: Vibrant matcha green tea sponge layered with a sweet, pastel pink berry cream, coated in smooth matcha frosting and topped with a cherry. Earthy, sweet, and perfectly balanced!
